hero.headline: Sports for every Butuanon.
hero.tagline: Programs, facilities and traditional games from the City Sports Office. Laro para sa tanan.

about.intro: The City Sports Office helps residents play, train and compete. We run community programs, support athletes and coaches, and look after the city's sports facilities.
mandate: Promote sports and physical fitness among residents
Support the city's athletes and delegations
Organize community sports programs and events
Manage and maintain city sports facilities

services.title: Community sports clinics
services.text: Beginner-friendly coaching sessions open to residents of all ages.

services.title: Athlete and delegation support
services.text: Assistance for local athletes and coaches joining competitions.

services.title: Sports events
services.text: City leagues, fun runs and tournaments throughout the year.

services.title: Fitness programs
services.text: Group exercise and wellness activities for the community.

facilities.note: To request a facility, send a letter to the office at least two weeks before your event.

laro.intro: Traditional Filipino games, playable right here.
